definitions.ask: Should a counted gg that lands below the first line (for example 120gg) also run zb?
definitions.why: zb only helps at the top of a note; elsewhere it hides the lines below the target

choices.label: Only gg and 1gg (which land on the first line) run zb; counted jumps keep today's scroll
Every gg runs zb, so 120gg parks line 120 at the bottom edge of the window
